name: @weavetab/plugin-chaos
description: Official Weavetab Chaos Engineering & Fault Injection Plugin. CDP network throttling, CPU slowdown, API fault mocking, DOM boundary fuzzing, and automated crash telemetry.

cdp.reason: Emulates network conditions, throttles CPU rate, intercepts requests via Fetch, and injects boundary payloads into DOM elements.

tools.reason: Registers the chaos_inject, chaos_fuzz, and chaos_report MCP tools.

tools.name: chaos_inject
tools.description: Runtime environmental fault injection over CDP. Emulates network throttling (offline/slow_3g/fast_3g/custom latency), CPU execution throttling (4x/6x slowdown), and API fault mocking (status codes, connection failures, artificial delays, custom responses via CDP Fetch).

action.description: Whether to apply faults or reset environmental conditions back to normal (default: 'apply').

network_profile.description: Pre-configured network degradation profile or 'reset' to restore unthrottled network.

latency_ms.description: Additional latency in milliseconds for custom network profile (e.g. 500).

download_kbps.description: Max download throughput in kbps for custom network profile (e.g. 250).

upload_kbps.description: Max upload throughput in kbps for custom network profile (e.g. 100).

cpu_throttle_rate.description: CPU throttling multiplier (e.g. 1 for normal, 4 for 4x slowdown, 6 for 6x slowdown).

url_pattern.description: URL glob pattern to intercept (e.g. '*api/checkout*' or '*user*').

response_body.description: Mocked JSON or text payload to return in response body.

fail_reason.description: Connection-level failure reason instead of HTTP status.

delay_ms.description: Simulated response latency/delay in milliseconds before mock responds.

mock_api.description: CDP Fetch API fault interception rules.

tools.name: chaos_fuzz
tools.description: Autonomous boundary testing and race-condition generator on forms and buttons. Executes rapid multi-clicks to trigger race conditions and injects boundary payloads (oversized, unicode edge, numeric bounds, injection probes) into DOM and Shadow DOM inputs.

mode.description: Fuzzing mode: 'race_click' fires rapid concurrent clicks, 'boundary_forms' injects edge-case values, 'all' runs both.

selector.description: Target CSS selector (e.g. 'button.submit', 'form#signup', or 'input'). Defaults to form or button inside body.

burst_count.description: Number of rapid consecutive clicks to dispatch for race-condition testing (default: 20).

payload_type.description: Type of boundary value payload to inject into inputs (default: 'all').

auto_submit.description: Whether to automatically trigger submit button click or form submission after injecting boundary inputs.

shadow_dom.description: Whether to recursively traverse and fuzz Shadow DOM elements (default: true).

key_events.description: Whether to fire synthetic keyboard events (Enter/Tab) during clicks and input mutations.

tools.name: chaos_report
tools.description: Captures CDP Runtime exceptions, network error codes (>= 400), and failed requests to generate structured Markdown or JSON bug reports with exact reproduction steps.

action.description: Operation: 'report' outputs bug report, 'start' attaches error listeners to current tab, 'clear' resets captured events.
